titleEn: Minimum Number of Visited Cells in a Grid
title: 网格图中最少访问的格子数
summary: 从左上角出发，位于 (r,c) 时可向右或向下移动至多 grid[r][c] 格，求到右下角最少访问格子数，不可达返回负一。
insight: 把每个格子作为无权图节点做 BFS，但不能逐格枚举长跳跃区间。为每行维护尚未访问列集合、每列维护尚未访问行集合；扩展时只从对应有序集合取落在可达区间的坐标并立即从行列两集合删除，因此每个格子仅被发现一次。
pitfalls: 值为零的格子无法继续移动
访问格子时必须同时从行集合和列集合删除
有序集合范围枚举后再从同一下界继续 ceiling

solutions.title: BFS 与行列未访问集合
solutions.idea: 用有序集合跳过已访问和不可达坐标。
steps: 每行 TreeSet 放所有列，每列 TreeSet 放所有行
distance 全 -1，起点为一并从两集合删除
在 row 集合中枚举 (col,min(cols-1,col+grid)) 的未访问列，赋距离、从行列集合删除并入队
在 col 集合中同理枚举向下区间

code.java: class Solution { public int minimumVisitedCells(int[][] grid){int rows=grid.length,cols=grid[0].length;TreeSet<Integer>[] rowUnvisited=new TreeSet[rows],colUnvisited=new TreeSet[cols];for(int row=0;row<rows;row++){rowUnvisited[row]=new TreeSet<>();for(int col=0;col<cols;col++)rowUnvisited[row].add(col);}for(int col=0;col<cols;col++){colUnvisited[col]=new TreeSet<>();for(int row=0;row<rows;row++)colUnvisited[col].add(row);}int[][] distance=new int[rows][cols];for(int[] line:distance)Arrays.fill(line,-1);distance[0][0]=1;rowUnvisited[0].remove(0);colUnvisited[0].remove(0);Queue<int[]> queue=new ArrayDeque<>();queue.add(new int[]{0,0});while(!queue.isEmpty()){int[] cell=queue.poll();int row=cell[0],col=cell[1],limit=grid[row][col];int maximumCol=Math.min(cols-1,col+limit);Integer nextCol=rowUnvisited[row].ceiling(col+1);while(nextCol!=null&&nextCol<=maximumCol){int destination=nextCol;rowUnvisited[row].remove(destination);colUnvisited[destination].remove(row);distance[row][destination]=distance[row][col]+1;queue.add(new int[]{row,destination});nextCol=rowUnvisited[row].ceiling(col+1);}int maximumRow=Math.min(rows-1,row+limit);Integer nextRow=colUnvisited[col].ceiling(row+1);while(nextRow!=null&&nextRow<=maximumRow){int destination=nextRow;colUnvisited[col].remove(destination);rowUnvisited[destination].remove(col);distance[destination][col]=distance[row][col]+1;queue.add(new int[]{destination,col});nextRow=colUnvisited[col].ceiling(row+1);}}return distance[rows-1][cols-1];} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun minimumVisitedCells(grid:Array<IntArray>):Int{val rows=grid.size;val cols=grid[0].size;val rowUnvisited=Array(rows){java.util.TreeSet<Int>()};val colUnvisited=Array(cols){java.util.TreeSet<Int>()};for(row in 0 until rows)for(col in 0 until cols){rowUnvisited[row].add(col);colUnvisited[col].add(row)};val distance=Array(rows){IntArray(cols){-1}};distance[0][0]=1;rowUnvisited[0].remove(0);colUnvisited[0].remove(0);val queue=java.util.ArrayDeque<IntArray>();queue.add(intArrayOf(0,0));while(queue.isNotEmpty()){val cell=queue.removeFirst();val row=cell[0];val col=cell[1];val limit=grid[row][col];val maximumCol=minOf(cols-1,col+limit);var nextCol=rowUnvisited[row].ceiling(col+1);while(nextCol!=null&&nextCol<=maximumCol){val destination=nextCol;rowUnvisited[row].remove(destination);colUnvisited[destination].remove(row);distance[row][destination]=distance[row][col]+1;queue.add(intArrayOf(row,destination));nextCol=rowUnvisited[row].ceiling(col+1)};val maximumRow=minOf(rows-1,row+limit);var nextRow=colUnvisited[col].ceiling(row+1);while(nextRow!=null&&nextRow<=maximumRow){val destination=nextRow;colUnvisited[col].remove(destination);rowUnvisited[destination].remove(col);distance[destination][col]=distance[row][col]+1;queue.add(intArrayOf(destination,col));nextRow=colUnvisited[col].ceiling(row+1)}};return distance[rows-1][cols-1]} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public:int minimumVisitedCells(vector<vector<int>>& grid){int rows=grid.size(),cols=grid[0].size();vector<set<int>> rowUnvisited(rows),colUnvisited(cols);for(int row=0;row<rows;++row)for(int col=0;col<cols;++col){rowUnvisited[row].insert(col);colUnvisited[col].insert(row);}vector<vector<int>> distance(rows,vector<int>(cols,-1));distance[0][0]=1;rowUnvisited[0].erase(0);colUnvisited[0].erase(0);queue<pair<int,int>> pending;pending.push({0,0});while(!pending.empty()){auto [row,col]=pending.front();pending.pop();int limit=grid[row][col],maximumCol=min(cols-1,col+limit);auto column=rowUnvisited[row].lower_bound(col+1);while(column!=rowUnvisited[row].end()&&*column<=maximumCol){int destination=*column;column=rowUnvisited[row].erase(column);colUnvisited[destination].erase(row);distance[row][destination]=distance[row][col]+1;pending.push({row,destination});}int maximumRow=min(rows-1,row+limit);auto line=colUnvisited[col].lower_bound(row+1);while(line!=colUnvisited[col].end()&&*line<=maximumRow){int destination=*line;line=colUnvisited[col].erase(line);rowUnvisited[destination].erase(col);distance[destination][col]=distance[row][col]+1;pending.push({destination,col});}}return distance.back().back();} };
